# opentls.library API headers

The public headers of opentls.library, API version 1 (frozen 9 October
2026), from DalsinAI/openamigatls (branch `opentls/api-20261009`, commit
dedb61c), unchanged. MIT licensed and free, Copyright (c) 2026 Dalsin
Limited (`LICENSE`). The contract is that repository's
`docs/AutoDocs-OpenTLS.md`; later versions only add, so these keep
working. OpenPrint's OpenTLS backend (`src/tls/tls_opentls.c`) is built
against them; the library itself is opened at run time, never linked.
